args.body: Use the queued live-intake-reading-evidence.json after its receipt confirms publication. Read the full EN/FR page as well as the decoded templates before judging equivalent wording. Decide from the live copy whether it already offers a case-specific diagnosis, a supported minimal correction and an output comparison against expected rows. If it does, save the exact quotations and close under valid ownership with a lesson. If it omits that outcome, stage the smallest change and test the fictional inquiry against the committed FULFILLMENT handoff before requesting independent exact-digest review. No public deployment under this mission.
